summary: The Model Context Protocol (MCP) has become the de facto standard for connecting AI agents to external tools, data, and services through a uniform interface. By 2026, the ecosystem has matured around remote, OAuth-secured hosted endpoints from major vendors, aggregator platforms that bundle thousands of integrations, and gateways that handle auth, routing, and observability at scale. This matters because MCP lets any compliant AI assistant read resources and invoke tools without bespoke per-integration code.
ecosystem_note: Individual MCP servers expose one product or capability (e.g. GitHub or Playwright), aggregators bundle many servers behind a single connection and auth layer (e.g. Composio, Smithery), and gateways/proxies sit in front of servers to manage authentication, routing, rate-limiting, and observability (e.g. Cloudflare MCP, agentgateway).

tools.name: GitHub MCP Server
tools.connects_to: Repositories, issues, pull requests, Actions, code search and file contents
tools.pricing_paid: Included with GitHub plans; usage governed by existing GitHub subscription tiers
strengths: Massive developer install base and ecosystem default
tools.best_for: Automating repository workflows, code review, and CI/CD orchestration from AI agents

tools.name: Playwright MCP Server
tools.connects_to: Browser automation, web navigation, scraping, UI testing and interaction
strengths: Lets agents drive real browsers reliably
Accessibility-tree-based actions rather than brittle pixel matching
Widely adopted for agentic web testing
tools.best_for: Browser control, end-to-end testing, and web automation for AI agents

tools.name: Composio (Rube MCP)
tools.connects_to: 250+ apps and tools via a single MCP endpoint with managed auth
tools.pricing_paid: Paid team/enterprise tiers for higher usage, SSO, and support
strengths: Single connection unlocks hundreds of integrations
tools.best_for: Giving agents broad tool access without wiring each integration manually

tools.name: Cloudflare MCP
tools.connects_to: Hosting and securing remote MCP servers with OAuth, Workers, and edge routing
tools.pricing_paid: Workers paid plans scale with usage beyond the free tier
strengths: Easy deployment of secure hosted endpoints
tools.best_for: Deploying and securing remote MCP servers at the edge

tools.name: Supabase MCP Server
tools.connects_to: Postgres databases, tables, rows, auth, and storage
tools.pricing_paid: Supabase Pro and higher plans for production usage
strengths: Lets agents query and manage databases directly
tools.best_for: Letting AI agents read and manage Postgres data and backend resources

tools.name: Notion MCP Server
tools.connects_to: Pages, databases, docs, and workspace content
tools.pricing_paid: Included with Notion paid workspace plans
strengths: Widely used for agent context and docs
tools.best_for: Giving agents access to team knowledge bases and docs

tools.name: Figma MCP Server
tools.connects_to: Design files, frames, components, and design-to-code context
tools.best_for: Feeding design context into code-generation and UI agents

tools.name: Stripe MCP Server
tools.connects_to: Payments, customers, invoices, subscriptions, and billing data
tools.pricing_paid: Standard Stripe transaction fees apply; no separate MCP fee
strengths: Lets agents query and manage payments safely
tools.best_for: Automating billing, payments, and financial data queries from agents

tools.name: Smithery
tools.connects_to: Thousands of MCP servers via a registry and hosted deployment layer
tools.pricing_paid: Paid hosting and higher usage tiers for teams
strengths: Large searchable registry of MCP servers
Central discovery hub for the ecosystem
tools.best_for: Discovering, installing, and hosting MCP servers from one registry

tools.name: Docker MCP Toolkit
tools.connects_to: Containerized MCP servers managed and isolated via Docker Desktop
tools.pricing_paid: Docker Business/Team plans for organizational usage
strengths: Secure sandboxed execution of MCP servers
Easy local management and gateway routing
tools.best_for: Running MCP servers securely in isolated containers with a unified gateway

tools.name: Sentry MCP Server
tools.connects_to: Error tracking, issues, performance data, and stack traces
strengths: Lets agents triage and debug production errors
tools.best_for: AI-assisted debugging and error triage from live production data

tools.name: Linear MCP Server
tools.connects_to: Issues, projects, cycles, and team workflows
tools.best_for: Automating issue tracking and project management from agents
